'''Efridge Engelhardt Hidden Mains Podracing''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Efridge Engelhardt]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18012">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18012 Hidden Mains Podracing], DeckTech (Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt, 2 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18012/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18012/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Hidden Mains Podracing'''
* '''Author:''' Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt
* '''Published:''' August 2, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Mains+retrieval backed up by huge destiny draws.

=== Strategy ===

This deck was inspired by Chris Mcclure's version of hidden mains podracing.  It's pretty straight forward. Win the podrace, dominate tatooine in space and on the ground, set up celebration and win by like 35.  Good luck =)
